name: Ebola & haemorrhagic fevers
summary: DR Congo Ebola outbreak passes 10,500 confirmed cases and 5,100 deaths; cases also in Kenya and Nigeria
state: ECDC counted 10,532 confirmed cases and 5,126 deaths in DR Congo as of 2 Nov, with 65 new cases reported that day and eight provinces affected; Kenya has nine confirmed cases and Nigeria reported one on 20 Oct (ECDC). Since 3 Nov, travellers to the US must attest they have not been in DR Congo in the previous 21 days (Nature World News).
for_you: Follow NaTHNaC and UKHSA advice if travelling to DR Congo, Kenya or neighbouring countries; ECDC rates the risk to people in Europe as very low.
rubric_hit: More than 1,000 cases and spread to a new country in 30 days = Alert
basis_detail: WHO, Africa CDC and ECDC case counts
basis_by: WHO, Africa CDC and ECDC case counts

sources.title: ECDC — Ebola disease outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus, 3 Nov update
Nature World News — Ebola cases top 10,000 in Congo

why: Ebola, Marburg and similar viruses kill a large share of those infected; outbreaks that reach cities or cross borders can overwhelm health systems.
drivers: Surveillance and contact tracing, vaccine availability (none licensed for some strains), conflict, cross-border travel, health-worker infections.

rubric.alert: More than 1,000 cases, or spread to a new country in the past 30 days.
rubric.watch: An active outbreak contained within one country, or fewer than 1,000 cases.
rubric.normal: No active Ebola/Marburg outbreak, or outbreaks declining with no new countries affected in 60 days.
